conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For example, superposition is like a spinning coin that is both heads and tails until it lands. Entanglement is like having two coins that always land on the same side, even if flipped far apart.

conversation.message: Those analogies really help! So, how does this all lead to faster calculations?
